front_door.description: Arched recessed doorway, appears set back from small front garden; door seen painted dark green; 2–3 steps up from path behind a low front wall.

access_notes: Narrow frontage with low brick/rendered wall and short path from pavement.
Permit parking signpost on pavement near frontage.
Telecoms/utility cabinet on pavement by the frontage marked “15”.
No hydrant marker or standpipe plate visible in the images.
obstacles: Timber/telegraph pole and street lighting column along pavement.
rear_access_note: Rear gardens back directly onto other properties’ gardens; no alley or side passage visible from road or satellite view.
parking: On-street parking bays on Deerbrook Road directly outside; an appliance could stop kerbside space permitting.
